EURO 10 🇪🇺 — Week of 13–19 Nov

New method this week: we added up the official singles charts of Italy, France, Germany and the UK, rap only, 101 points minus chart position. Three national #1s stop at 100 points: SDM & Ninho in France, Kid Yugi in Italy, Ski Aggu & Ericson in Germany. Season 25's "SHOTTA'S." is the only rap song in two of the four charts (#16 Germany, #17 UK) and takes #1 with 169. Last week we asked: Vacra or Tiakola? Answer: neither.

🎧 Track: SHOTTA'S. – Season 25

Next week's #1: Season 25 or SDM? Comment 1 or 2.
